title: Algebraic Dimension and Reduction of LVMB manifolds
summary: LVMB manifolds are a large class of compact complex non-Kähler and non-algebraic manifolds, constructed from an algebro-combinatorial datum. We provide an upper bound on their algebraic dimension and prove it to be sharp. Comparing our result with the lower bound found by Meersseman, we obtain the exact algebraic dimension of an LVMB manifold in many relevant cases. Pursuing our analysis further, we also obtain a description of the algebraic reduction of an LVMB manifold.
